text: Habitdone is truly remarkable. Its design is visually appealing. It is amazing. The interface is beautiful. It has unique and comprehensive functions. It really helps me form good habits. The functions are not only distinctive but also all - inclusive. It's so user-friendly that it makes managing tasks and habits a breeze. Highly recommended!
author: He Noelle

text: Beautiful and practical app I have used many habit recording apps, but none of them look good like this! The viewing methods of weekly and monthly views are particularly satisfying, and they are very intuitive for one's weekly or monthly clock in records. There are also desktop widgets that facilitate direct recording. Unlocking my phone will remind me to clock in. The online disk synchronization function is very practical.
author: Jasmine Lo

text: After trying it out, I found the experience to be quite good. Clocking in is very convenient, just a single click, and there are animations when completing habits. However, regular users can only create up to 3 habits. To create an unlimited number of habits, you need to subscribe The U1 design is simple and aesthetically pleasing, making it very convenient to clock in. You can see the monthly clock-in time directly on the homepage, unlike others where you have to go to the statistics section
author: Peak Pan (留夏)

text: This is a very easy-to-use habit punch-in software. I think the interface setting is the best on the market. I like this interface very much. There are multiple view statistics in it, and I like the color matching of the page very much. You can set it yourself. The page is simple and clean.
author: jw z

text: "HabitDone is an excellent habit-building app that has significantly helped me develop and maintain healthy habits. The user interface is clean and intuitive, making it easy to navigate and set up new goals. The reminders are reliable and keep me accountable. Overall, I'm highly impressed with this app and would recommend it to anyone looking to improve their habits!"
author: Joe Li

text: This app has completely transformed how I manage my daily habits. The user-friendly design makes tracking simple, while helpful reminders keep me motivated and consistent. I love how it helps me stay organized and focus on building better routines. I’ve already noticed positive changes in my routine. Highly recommend it to anyone wanting to improve their lifestyle!
author: x x

text: Absolutely love this habit-checking app! The interface is stunningly beautiful, and the widgets are not just visually appealing but also highly functional. The statistics feature is a game-changer, providing clear insights into my progress. It's intuitive, user-friendly, and has become an indispensable part of my daily routine. Highly recommended for anyone looking to track and improve their habits.
author: 张心怡

text: Habitdone is a beautifully designed habit tracker with a minimalist interface that's both elegant and user-friendly. Its intuitive layout and smooth performance make habit tracking a breeze. Features are streamlined, focusing on what matters—helping users build and maintain habits effectively. A perfect app for those who value simplicity and aesthetics in habit formation.
author: 张文钦

text: This is the best habit tracker app I ever used! I feel more productive after using this app!

text: I’ve been using HabitDone for a few weeks now, and it’s honestly been a game-changer for me. I love how simple yet effective it is—I actually look forward to checking off my habits every day. The streak feature keeps me motivated, and I’ve already started seeing positive changes in my routine. Highly recommend it!
author: Steven Jobs

text: HabitDone is an amazing app for building and tracking habits! The interface is clean and super easy to use, making it simple to set and stick to daily goals. The progress tracker and reminders are a great motivator to stay consistent. Perfect for anyone looking to improve their routines and productivity!

text: HabitDone is super easy to use and has really helped me stay on top of my habits. I love how simple it is to track progress and stay motivated. It’s been a game changer for keeping my routines on track!

text: HabitDone - Build Good Habits& Reach Your Goals HabitDone helps you create lasting habits and stay motivated.Track your goals with customizable daily,weekly,or long-term habits,set reminders,and visualize your progress.Whether you're working on fitness,productivity,learning,or self-care,HabitDone keeps you consistent.With easy-to-use features,progress charts and motivational reminders,this app empowers you to stay on track and achieve your personal growth goals.

text: 安卓平台上的大部分打卡软件我都试用过，habitdone无疑是最符合我审美的App，非常貌美UI设计很合理，可视化效果非常直观。 只需要点击“done”就能完成打卡;还能轻松切换年月日 圆环视图;对于多次打卡的习惯，热力图的颜色会根据打 卡次数有深浅不同的显示；主页上的习惯总数和完成率t 能清晰地提醒你今天的打卡状态。 分享功能:美观的习惯卡片，随时晒出你的进步，记录成 长。 背景色选择:多种背景色随心搭配，打卡过程也能充满乐 趣。 心仪图标：多种图标可选,个性化定制你的习惯。 多种打卡模式:随心选择,轻松养成好习惯。
